title: Home Purchase Agreement Collections: Product Lines and Base Price Bands
content:
The collection written on a Home Purchase Agreement is set by the product line of the plan and the band its base price falls in. Each of the six collections covers one product line and one base price band, from the lowest base price of a plan in the collection to the highest.

## Collection schedule

| Collection | Product line | Lowest base price (USD) | Highest base price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | Townhome | 279990.00 | 349989.00 |
| Meadow Collection | Single-family, 40 ft homesite | 349990.00 | 449989.00 |
| Heritage Collection | Single-family, 50 ft homesite | 449990.00 | 574989.00 |
| Crestview Collection | Single-family, 60 ft homesite | 574990.00 | 724989.00 |
| Summit Collection | Single-family, 70 ft homesite | 724990.00 | 949989.00 |
| Reserve Collection | Estate, 80 ft homesite | 949990.00 | 1499990.00 |

Both figures of a band are inclusive: a plan priced exactly at the lowest or exactly at the highest figure of a band sits inside that band. The bands meet without a gap, so the highest figure of one collection is one dollar below the lowest figure of the next.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A single-family plan for a 50 ft homesite listed at a hypothetical base price of 512000.00 sits in the Heritage Collection band (449990.00 through 574989.00).
- A hypothetical 40 ft single-family plan priced at 449989.00 is at the top of the Meadow Collection band; one priced at 449990.00 would be at the bottom of the Heritage Collection band.
- A townhome plan belongs to the Pathway Collection, whose band runs from 279990.00 to 349989.00.

The collection named on the agreement is the official tier name used throughout the Home Purchase Agreement schedules for deposits, contingencies, incentives, closing terms and fees.
